column2: I hate this world too...! I hate it!
Honey...
Hover set! Pilder ON!
Scrander! CROSS!
Is that... the undersea fortress Saluud?\n\nBut something's off... Let's check it out.
Let's go see!
Black things are stuck all over the undersea fortress Saluud!
Are the black things controlling the Mechanical Beasts and attacking the Saluud?
Hmm? That's Mazinger Z!
Could these black things be Mazinger Z's new weapon?
Better talk it over with Professor Yumi...
Professor Yumi! There's a radio call from Koji-kun.
Yumi here. What is it?
{!R}Black things are controlling the Mechanical Beasts and attacking the undersea fortress Saluud. {!R}Professor Yumi... what should I do?
Hmmm...
We could always let them wipe each other out...?
No, that... won't do!\n\nKoji-kun! Save the Saluud!
{!R}You want me to side with Dr. Hell?
The Mechanical Beast army and the black things are both our enemies, certainly. But the black things are deeply tied to the Dimension Chain.
{!R}So Dr. Hell's after world domination, {!R}but the Dimension Chain could destroy the world, right?
Exactly, Koji-kun!
{!R}Understood, Professor! I'll go rescue the Saluud!
Good. I'm counting on you!
Things just keep getting more complicated... I must do something!
Baron Ashura! I don't like it, but I'm on your side!
Don't be absurd!
Aren't these black things your friends!?
Talk later! If you don't wanna die, fight with me!
Silence! As if I'd ever
join hands with the likes of you!
Ngggh...!
Mechanical Beasts, why!?
Tch! I can't just stand here and watch!
I understand, Koji Kabuto.\n\nIt seems the Demon King is a common enemy to us both.
Just what I'd expect from Dr. Hell. You catch on quick.
I had noticed the Dimension Chain as well. I won't let the world be destroyed!
Whaaat!
You would disobey the orders of Dr. Hell!?
Never,
but...
Understood, Baron Ashura? Go with Koji Kabuto and fight!
But mark me, Koji Kabuto!\n\nWhen this battle is over, we shall be enemies once more. Never forget it!
Of course!
Wahahahahaha...!
Listen, this is the perfect chance to spy on their forces!
I see...!
Once the battle is over, this time you WILL steal Mazinger Z!
A marvelous scheme!
What are you guys whispering about?
Our own business!
Eavesdropping is so rude!
Now, now! Yesterday's enemy is today's friend! Wahahahahaha...!
Baron Ashura! You will go with Koji Kabuto!
Cheer up, {p}! This is Professor Yumi we're talking about. He hasn't abandoned {s}!
In manga and games, they always save the kidnapped heroine for a happy ending, right? It'll work out for sure!
Thanks, you two...
Wanna go see Professor Yumi? He might've found something. He should be in the room at the back of this floor.
Koji-kun might be back too!
Yeah...
While the black thing was controlling me, I felt a strange sense of peace. It was as if two things clicked perfectly into one...
It felt like I'd met a wonderful boss or leader...\n\nSo I can understand why the people outside worship the Demon King.
When the black thing controls you, your mind goes blank... But I felt a strong sense of mission.
I felt like anything I did would be forgiven! I think that's why I got so violent.
That's interesting... Thank you for the report.
Then I'll be going!
You came at just the right time. New information has come in.
Our guard-kun just told me. Take a look at the news.
{!R}People who were controlled by black things and claim to have heard the Demon King's voice {!R}are beginning to gather in one place!
It's the Hill of Beginnings!
{!R}These people have begun building an altar on this hill! {!R}They're even making an eerie statue!
An altar and a statue?
{!R}People who worship the Demon King are gathering one after another!
They say the people are saying the same words you heard, {p}-kun.
The words I heard?
The time of joining...
Greater power...
Ambition realized...
This can only mean one thing!
The Demon King hasn't gained his full power yet...!
I don't know what the time of joining means. But when it comes, the Demon King will unleash his true power!
Before that happens... we have to do something!
We'd like to build up our forces somehow too. The way Baron Ashura joined us...
Whaaat!?
Nooo!
Isn't that just a bogus tip?
It's true! The fact is, black things attacked the undersea fortress Saluud.
So, to counter the threat of the black things, we've joined hands with the Mechanical Beast army for the time being.
Well, that's... reassuring, or... something...
It's complicated, isn't it?\n\nIt just shows how fierce the black things have gotten.
But maybe it's a chance to make friends with people who used to be enemies!
We must all stand united against this crisis!
Gennosuke Yumi speaking.\n\nI see. Understood.
They've driven the rioters away from the residential area. I have a meeting now, so I'll excuse myself.
Baron Ashura on our side... It's a weird feeling, huh?
We'll go outside after we check the situation with Professor Yumi.
We'll go outside after we check the situation with Dr. Saotome.

The Demon King calls {p}-kun the "Sun of rebirth" and {s}-kun the "Moon of destruction." And the rioters are saying to hand {p}-kun over to the Demon King. I believe this is connected to what the Demon King calls the "time of joining."
Don't leave the residential area. If the Demon King captures you, this "time of joining" may come...
